name: coreutils-small-07

deferred_intrinsics.reason: C2Rust 0.22.1 cannot translate __builtin_cpu_supports used by GNU wc's AVX2 runtime dispatch. Preserve that optimized behavior for a typed CPU-feature bridge instead of hard-coding a result.

selection_policy: The next measured-smallest canonical archives after batch six whose captured translation units contain neither SELinux nor systemd support. Expand and unexpand are kept in separate batches because they capture expand-common.c under distinct applet configurations. Chmod and mkdir are deferred to the canonical no-SELinux build. Wc moved to the CPU-dispatch bridge queue and join is substituted.
